// Bookings: the lifecycle of a stay. An instance is a booking id; its folio in Ledger has the same id.
signal check_out(id: String, day: Int) -> Map   // Bookings
    // Check-out on day `day`. Nothing may be due on the folio (error `Unpaid`). checked_in ->
    // checked_out, the room becomes dirty, the nights from `day` on are freed (an early
    // departure releases them; no refund), and the guest earns points on the CASH paid on the
    // folio (Loyalty.earn). Returns map("ok", true, "points", <the guest's points afterwards>).
reads      depart: Map<String, Int> [persistent]   // booking -> day of departure (arrive < depart)
           guests: Map<String, String> [persistent]   // booking -> guest
           rooms: Map<String, String> [persistent]   // booking -> room
moves      checked_in -> checked_out
machine    stay — one instance per id (the String or Int you pass); initial `requested`
               get_status(id) is () until the id's first transition (edition 2026: `requested`) — write `get_status(id) ?? "requested"`
               requested -> confirmed
               confirmed -> checked_in
               checked_in -> checked_out
               confirmed -> cancelled
               confirmed -> no_show
calls      Calendar.free_nights(booking: String, room: String, from: Int, to: Int) -> Int   writes nights
               // Frees the nights from <= d < to of `room` that `booking` holds (others are left alone). Returns how many were freed.
               requires from < to
           Housekeeping.vacate(room: String) -> String            moves occupied -> dirty
               // occupied -> dirty. Returns "dirty".
           Ledger.cash_paid(folio: String) -> Int                 reads cash
               // Total paid in cash on the folio.
           Ledger.due(folio: String) -> Int                       reads cash, charged, points_paid
               // charged - cash - points_paid; 0 for an unknown folio.
           Loyalty.earn(guest: String, cash_amount: Int) -> Int   writes balance
               // Credits one point per full 100 cents of `cash_amount`. Returns the guest's points afterwards.
               requires cash_amount >= 0
